verdict.rationale: Vestd documents a digital cap table and data rooms that can hold cap tables, but nothing in the evidence shows a public API, export endpoint, or agent interface for pulling cap table data programmatically. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, the HRIS integration is an inbound data sync, and the llms.txt file only describes the company, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent pull my current cap table programmatically and reconcile it against my data room before a financing
